matrix.package_versioning: SemanticVersion pins; publishing never mutates a pinned install; incompatible package upgrades fork.
matrix.snapshot_policy: Snapshot is an optimization/baseline; replay from events remains authoritative.
matrix.correction_policy: Historical truth is corrected with new events/branches or explicit migration; never silent mutation.

event_schema.replay_version_checks: ReplayEngine._check_event raises IncompatibleVersion on schema/rule mismatch
event_schema.commit_version_checks: CommitAuthority._enforce_preconditions raises IncompatibleVersion on rule mismatch

snapshot_schema.content_ref: opaque reference; state rebuilt via replay

forensics.package_versioning: Exact pins + schema_pins; incompatible upgrade forks; vN never mutates vN-1 installs.
forensics.correction_policy: New events/branches or explicit migration semantics only; no silent overwrite of canonical history.
forensics.silent_defaulting_scan: No unknown-field defaulting that changes semantic meaning (serialization is explicit; unknown keys rejected by expect_version).
